text: The morning coffee queue at Termini was moving at a crawl because the contactless card reader kept freezing and failing. Took 18 minutes just to pay for a cappuccino.
author: Matteo Rossi

text: Ordered pistachio gelato on Deliveroo. It arrived completely melted into warm soup because the courier said the shop left it sitting on the warm counter near the coffee grinders.
author: Federica Moretti

text: I asked for oat milk because of severe lactose intolerance, but the barista gave me whole cow milk. Luckily I noticed before drinking, but this is a serious health hazard.
author: Giulia Bianchi

text: Delicious pastries and wonderful coffee, but the tap-to-pay machine declined my card three times before the cashier rebooted the terminal. Other customers were visibly frustrated.
author: Andrea Conti

text: Second time my delivery gelato arrives totally liquid. You cannot package frozen gelato in paper cups and let it sit at room temperature waiting for riders to arrive.
author: Simone Romano

text: Ordered an iced latte with almond milk, received dairy milk instead. Staff seemed rushed and completely ignored special dietary instructions on the order ticket.
author: Chiara De Luca

text: Card terminal crashed during peak 8:30 AM commute rush. Only one cashier could take cash, and half the line walked out to the cafe across the street.
author: Lorenzo Esposito

text: The gelato flavor is incredible, but courier packaging needs insulated thermal pouches with dry ice or freeze packs during summer months.
author: Valentina Ricci

text: Staff gave my mobile pickup order to someone else because they only call out names instead of verifying order numbers on the phone screen.
author: Marco Leone

text: Love the roast beans, but drink customizations and non-dairy milks are mixed up far too frequently during rush hours.
author: Davide Ferrari
